source: Isolated official SteamCMD package; read-only native-reference comparison against recorded build 26335264. No native game execution in this static review.

release.name: HumanitZ Hotfix 1.1Z
release.scope: The release removes Halloween content and fixes gameplay, UI, map and item-spawner issues. It does not announce new dedicated-server configuration, launch arguments, RCON commands or save formats. 1.2 Experimental and UE5 migration are future work.

configuration.module_coverage: All 92 editable native setting keys are represented by schema controls. RConPort belongs to the instance port model; Version is a reference identifier and is not rendered. The three optional 1.1 controls and the single RecycleCar assignment remain unchanged.

rcon_reference.save_contract: Native RCON save remains an exact request-ID 0, response-ID 1/type 0/Game saved! exchange in the existing adapter. Static reference and executable identity do not establish a fresh native ACK, durable save or restart readback. Formal receipts remain Requested.

source_alignment.scope: Before this provenance refresh, the complete HumanitZ module tree excluding Python bytecode cache, plus five dedicated transport/render source and test files, matched between local and execution sources. This is source alignment, not compiled-binary identity.

scope: The candidate identity matches the refreshed public build. Configuration and RCON references, plus the Shipping executable, are byte-identical to the prior build; no manager behavior change is required by this static comparison. The game package can still contain changed assets. Native readiness, authenticated info/Players/save, normal stop/restart and retained-world behavior require separate current-build verification.
